lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns, situated on the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse elevated luminance aligned with the vertical spot columns, forming a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct parallel horizontal features characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, transitioning from high-intensity highlights on the superior edge to low-intensity shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A secondary elongated biological entity (remora) is visible as a low-luminance form positioned ventral to the shark's posterior-lateral flank.
